More realistic passing of departure levels - cross the target to pass.
New ship - SS Atlantic.

notes.notes: Visible ships damage with hull deformation at collisions

notes.notes:
Icebergs settings are valid in sandbox mode too.

notes.notes:
New high-detailed ship - vehicles carrier.
Improved ships layout at levels.

notes.title: Version 1.06
Version 1.05
notes.notes:
High maneuverable platform supply vessel with contra-rotating propellers ASD (azimuth stern drive) and thrusters instead of passenger ASD ship (it's available in the Cruise Ship Handling app).
UI is better adapted to different screen resolutions.
Reduced app size.

notes.title: Version 1.04

Two new ships:
- Battlecruiser HMS Repulse;
- Japanese aircraft carrier Shokaku.
Improved levels with buildings.

notes.title: Version 1.03
notes.notes:
New special ships - Fruit Juice Tanker and Livestock Carrier.
New levels.
AI ship traffic control.

notes.title: Version 1.02
notes.notes:
New ship - cargo steamer of the early 20th century.
New levels with improved landscape.

Icebergs.
